notes: Small deterministic evidence set for local demos. Text is illustrative and should not be treated as source filings.

evidence.title: AAPL services revenue and margin context
evidence.text: Apple services revenue expanded as subscriptions, payments, and cloud offerings contributed recurring gross profit. Hardware cycles still influence reported growth and margin mix.

evidence.title: AAPL supply chain risk context
evidence.text: Apple disclosed that supplier concentration, component availability, foreign exchange, and demand timing can pressure revenue, working capital, and product margin.

evidence.title: MSFT cloud revenue and AI capacity
evidence.text: Microsoft cloud revenue growth remained tied to Azure consumption, enterprise renewals, AI infrastructure demand, and disciplined operating expense management.

evidence.title: JPM credit and deposit risk context
evidence.text: JPMorgan credit performance depends on consumer health, commercial loan quality, interest rate conditions, deposit betas, and capital markets activity.

evidence.title: XOM commodity and cash flow context
evidence.text: Exxon Mobil cash flow is sensitive to crude oil prices, refining margins, project execution, capital discipline, and shareholder distribution policy.

evidence.title: SPY broad market risk context
evidence.text: Broad market returns can be affected by earnings breadth, valuation, rates, inflation expectations, liquidity, and sector concentration.
